faqs.question: What is Ashmita Vinyls?
faqs.answer: Ashmita Vinyls is a premier manufacturer and supplier of commercial and industrial PVC vinyl products, strip curtains, and hanging systems across India.

faqs.question: What types of PVC strip curtains are available?
faqs.answer: We offer standard transparent, ribbed double-rib, polar freezer grade (-40°C), anti-static, anti-insect amber yellow, and welding screen PVC curtains.

faqs.question: How do I choose the correct strip thickness and width?
faqs.answer: For pedestrian doors up to 7-8 ft, 2mm x 200mm is recommended. For warehouse fork-lift openings or high wind exposure, 3mm x 300mm or 4mm x 400mm with 50% to 100% overlap is ideal.

faqs.question: Can Ashmita Vinyls customize curtain sizes and mounting brackets?
faqs.answer: Yes, we fabricate custom door sizes with pre-punched strips and provide high-grade Stainless Steel 202/304 and Mild Steel powder-coated mounting rails.

faqs.question: How do I request a bulk quote or place an order?
faqs.answer: You can reach out through our Connect Us page, call our sales helpline, or email info@ashmitavinyls.com for prompt quotations and B2B pricing.
